name: coordkit-marketplace
description: Multi-instance Claude Code coordination: a shared bus + ledger that warns about concurrent edits (coordkit), and an optional hard anti-clobber blocker (coordguard).

plugins.name: coordkit
plugins.description: Same-machine coordination bus + cross-instance ledger. WARN-only: tracks who else is live in a repo and which files they touch, and surfaces it — never blocks a tool call.

plugins.name: coordguard
plugins.description: Hard anti-clobber guard. Blocks a Write/Edit when a file changed on disk since this session last saw it (a sibling Claude instance likely edited it). Kept separate from coordkit so the bus stays strictly never-blocks.
